description: This file defines the SetValue class used to represent DynamoDB set types within the AWS SDK for PHP. It encapsulates the set values, provides methods for serialization, counting, and iteration.

classes.name: SetValue
classes.description: A class representing a DynamoDB set (SS/NS/BS) value, supporting serialization, counting, and iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new SetValue instance with the provided array of set values.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the set values as an array suitable for PHP and JSON serialization.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of values in the set.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator to iterate over the set values.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns a value that can be serialized to JSON, representing the set values.
